in_marathi.name: Navya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New, Fresh, Youthful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nav', meaning new or young, Navya signifies the freshness and vitality of youth. In Hindu mythology, Navya is the name of a divine nymph, symbolizing renewal and regeneration.
